notes.title: Quest 2 / Pico fix
notes.content:
Dear Quest 2 / Pico and other recent headsets users,

[h3][b][EDIT Nov 16, 2022][/b] Quest 2 / Pico users should not be blocked in the game anymore. Big thanks to [b]Art of S*[/b] for his help.[/h3]

This patch is the first attempt at fixing the input issues that are blocking Quest 2 / Pico users in [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b]. Please let me know if this fixes the issues. If this does not fix the issues, please join the Discord server and help me find a solution.

[url=https://discord.gg/fYXqE9g]Click here to join the VR Furballs Discord![/url]

[b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] was released 4 years ago. At the time, there was only a few VR headsets out there. Plenty of great VR headsets were released since, and unfortunately I am not in a position where I can buy them all to test the game with them.

To make sure [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] keeps working with all the new headsets, [b]please help[/b]!

Thanks again to everyone playing [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b]!

Steeve
Gamily Studios

notes.title: Weekly #33 - Headed to PSVR

notes.title: HAPPY 2019 + BYE BYE 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473564/233587155f989cb80ee893cde5039ffe91bafef0.jpg[/img]

[h1]First of all, the Furballs and I wish you a [b]Wonderful, Happy, and Furry New Year[/b]![/h1]

But before jumping into 2019, which will be a really tough one for both the Furballs and myself, I'd like to [b]look back at 2018[/b]. It was the first year out in the world for the [b]VR Furballs[/b], and we had quite a lot of up and downs...


[h1]AN ENCOURAGING START[/h1]

[b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] got out in [b]Early Access on Steam on the 2nd of January 2018[/b], so it will be celebrating its first release day soon. Back then a few hundreds curious players gave it a try, and honestly I didn't expect that much at first. Quite a few YouTubers also tried it, and I was so pleased to see that a vast majority of them really enjoyed the game. Of course the game was not perfect, and far from being finished, but overall [b]this start was really encouraging[/b].


[h1]A LONG ROAD[/h1]

[b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] got [b]out of Early Access on the 21st of November 2018[/b], so it took 11 more months to finish the 30 missing levels of the game (as well as improving a looot of other things). It wasn't an easy period, especially when the game was not selling much anymore after the first weeks (merely one copy a day). Luckily a few of you were of great help, and having you around to help and encourage me made a huge difference, so... LionXV, shane4games, Flag, kylatae, BOLL, computerchy and FunkeymonkeyTTR... [b]THANK YOU[/b]. I know the Discord got a bit crowded lately, but I really hope you'll stick around.


[h1]THE ARCADE VERSION[/h1]

On the way I try to go the Arcade path (or "Location Based" market). Quite a few [b]VR Arcades[/b] have [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] in their catalog. But it does not take their either, and the revenue their are [b]negligible[/b]. I hope the addition of the [b]Party Mode[/b] will help a bit, but I'm not expecting too much.


[h1]THE RELEASE[/h1]

The official release was [b]somewhat disappointing[/b]. It reached my low target in term of sales, but once more, after the first week, it was back down to a copy a day or so. The Oculus Store release had the same effect. And finally, the Christmas update seems to not have helped much. On the positive note, I want to thank the LIV community here. A lot of LIV streamers made awesome mixed reality videos of the game the past 2 months, and once again, I was so happy to see that most of them enjoyed the game a lot.


[h1]THE RECEPTION[/h1]

This is from far the most positive aspect of this [b]VR Furballs[/b] adventure so far. The game counts now [b]98 Steam reviews, all of them positive[/b]! And there are soooo many sweet words in those reviews. I'm really happy and proud I managed to bring so much fun and joy to some of you by creating these adorable Furballs.


[h1]THE HAPPY TIMES[/h1]

There was also quite a few happy moments over the year, starting with every single time one of you wrote a nice Steam review, or a nice message on Discord, or streamed/uploaded a video of the game. There was also the [b]Early Access Level Creation Contest[/b]. I was amazed by the levels you all created. And there was those 2 times I presented the game in salons. 


[h1]THE HARD TRUTH[/h1]

But releasing a "simple" yet good game nowadays without a proper marketing budget seems to be mission impossible. There will always be those rare games that will shine and explode because of their exceptional attraction, but obviously [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] is not one of those. So, once again, to those who think that "making a good game" is all it takes, let me tell you that it is absolutely not the case.


[h1]THE UGLY[/h1]

I want to thank again all those influencers who accepted to give the game a try, and the few press that talked about [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b]. But then I want to point out all those bigger [b]VR influencers[/b] and that weirdly biased [b]VR press[/b] that never did. For some of the influencers (and the bigger they are, the more true it it), it is simply a money thing, they simply won't play games for free anymore, even if it is one of those rare gems, that's why you won't see [b]VR Furballs[/b] on these channels. And for that VR press, it's simply because they are extremely biased. They seem to be only interested in either certain types of games (FPS, space stuff, etc...), or of course, big brands. You can be sure that they all made big articles about the upcoming [b]Angry Birds VR[/b].


[h1]THE COMING YEAR[/h1]

2019 will be tough, for both the Furballs and I. It will be a happy tough for me, because I'm going to be a Dad. Not sure how happy it will be for the Furballs. As I said above, [b]Angry Birds VR[/b] is coming, and it already made a 100 times more noise than the Furballs did. Although I'm sure the Furballs will be up to the fight, it will be quite an unfair one. You will still see the [b]VR Furballs[/b] coming to the [b]PSVR [/b]and [b]Oculus Quest[/b] platforms this year, no matter what, but for sure, the arrival of the birds makes everything more complicated.


[h1]ALL IN ALL[/h1]

[b]Do I regret the VR Furballs adventure? No.[/b] I'm so proud of what I have achieved. It would of course have been better if it had been a financial success as well as a critical-acclaim... but I'm so happy it was at least one of them. Luckily the story doesn't end here, because I managed to maintain a healthy side-activity by freelancing for other game studios around the world half of the time. So I'll be carrying on with the [b]VR Furballs[/b] for at least another year!


[h1]I wish you and the [b]VR Furballs[/b] a happy and successful year 2019.[/h1]

    [*][b]New:[/b] Added Simplified Chinese language.
    [*][b]New:[/b] Added alarm system to prevent players to throw or hit [b]Furballs[/b] from outside the allowed perimeter when playing a Level or a Mini-game.

    [*][b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed usage of the Slingshot being misinterpreted as the Motion Controller when you held the Slingshot outside the perimeter while shooting.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473564/e3e92a10366e7f22d5a6ee192f6177027ab6aa51.jpg[/img]

    [*][strike]Ask you guys to help us translate the game in all the languages supported by Steam.[/strike] [DONE]

Thanks again to everyone playing [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b]! See you next week!

Steeve
Gamily Studios

That's it for this awesome first week! Thanks again to everyone playing [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b]! See you next week!

notes.title: Early Access Level Creation Contest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31473564/ccdfd5a6d950c3c4816b2f58f25e1728ed108f4e.jpg[/img]

[h1]WE WANT YOU![/h1]

Dear fellow builders, [b]VR Furballs - Demolition[/b] is now available in Early Access! It contains 29 of the 54 levels that will be available in its full version. You too have access to the very same [b]Level Editor[/b] we use to build these levels. So gear up and come help us build these missing levels!

[h1]3 T-SHIRTS TO WIN[/h1]

We will select up to 3 of your levels to be part of the final game. The talented builders of these levels will win a [b]VR Furballs[/b] T-shirt, and have their name added to the game credits.

[h1]HOW TO PARTICIPATE[/h1]

1. Finish the game to unlock the [b]Level Editor[/b]
2. Build a level
3. Send the level file to mylevel@vrfurballs.com

[h1]RESULTS[/h1]

The winners of this contest will be contacted by email when their level gets selected. An announcement will be published on Steam to celebrate the winners at the end of the Early Access period.
